title: arabis glabra f. columnalis
intro: Arabis glabra f. columnalis, commonly known as White Rockcress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Arabis glabra f. columnalis involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
